intro: Fully funded doctoral researcher position in environmental chemistry (AI4TECS project) at the University of Luxembourg. EUR 44,531 gross/year. Rolling review - early application encouraged.
description:
About the Position

The University of Luxembourg is hiring a doctoral researcher in environmental chemistry within the AI4TECS project, which develops AI-powered systems for identifying emerging contaminants in water systems. The researcher will combine environmental chemistry with non-target screening using high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) and AI-driven data analysis.

Your Role

  • Develop and apply non-target screening workflows (HRMS) for emerging contaminants
  • Contribute AI-based identification and prioritisation methods for water-quality data
  • Perform extensive laboratory work and collaborate on measurements within the group
  • Publish results and participate in project and network activities

Funding and Employment

Employment and financial support
ComponentDetails
PositionFixed-term doctoral researcher contract (full time)
SalaryEUR 44,531 gross per year (full time).
LocationUniversity of Luxembourg (campus per project)
NoteThe University of Luxembourg is a multilingual, international research university.

Eligibility and Requirements

Academic and research preparation
CriterionRequirement
Academic preparationMaster's degree in environmental science or engineering, cheminformatics or a closely related field.
Subject backgroundSolid background in environmental chemistry with a particular interest in non-target screening (HRMS).
Working styleStrong analytical and problem-solving abilities; willingness to do extensive lab work; strong interest in interdisciplinary research; team-oriented mindset with openness to feedback; proactive, self-driven approach to research.
LanguagesExcellent command of English plus B2-level proficiency in the language of their thesis.

About University of Luxembourg

University of Luxembourg is a multilingual public research university in Luxembourg. It offers bachelor's, master's and doctoral education across science, technology, law, economics, humanities and social sciences. Its research centres and international academic community support collaboration across disciplines, connecting study with topics such as digital transformation, finance and contemporary society.

Official website: https://www.uni.lu
